summary: Apply ISA 315, 330, 500 and 530 to audit planning, evidence and reporting. Explore the five-day practical course outline.
lede: International Standards on Auditing training helps audit professionals plan and document risk-responsive financial statement audits. For audit associates, seniors, managers, reviewers and financial reporting specialists, it develops skills in assessing risks and materiality, selecting procedures, evaluating evidence and sampling, and documenting findings and conclusions. The course also introduces audit reporting requirements and AI-assisted analysis at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, perform, review or support external financial statement audits under the International Standards on Auditing.
prerequisites: Prior experience with financial statements or audit work is recommended. Working familiarity with accounting records and basic audit procedures will help you apply the ISA case exercises. Coding or programming is not required.
